title: Kubernetes client credentials
whyItMatters: Kubeconfig files and cached client certificates identify clusters and can carry bearer tokens that grant cluster access.
notes: Includes config and cached plugin or token files. Cluster endpoints and certificates are not parsed.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy the kubeconfig file named in the plan to a trusted place if you still need those cluster contexts.
cleanup.signOut: Delete the client certificate or token this Mac used from each cluster, so it no longer authenticates.
steps: Copy the contexts you still need and check they work from another machine.
Remove this Mac's token or certificate from each cluster it can reach.
Delete the folder named in the plan, then empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Those clusters must be set up again from another machine; a token left valid still grants access.
cleanup.source: Kubernetes documentation, Organizing cluster access using kubeconfig files: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/configuration/organize-cluster-access-kubeconfig/
